owner: CC owns the code and the proofs. Akien owns the bound already given and not CC's to widen: orient, then constrain, then survey, and the other four wait on these three WORKING (ruling 2026-08-14-the-preamble-compiles-to-learn-not-to-be-cheap).

watchme.as_cast_verbatim: PROBE at cairn/devices/builder/machines/orient/probes/ — and this one is not optional, because the whole ticket is an honesty claim about a number. It carries the derived floor fraction over berthed orient packets and is ENOUGH when that fraction is measured rather than declared, i.e. when no packet's provenance was authored by its sender. The drift it exists to catch is precise and likely: a later change that lets a caller pass provenance through again, which would silently restore the self-report this build removes and leave the dial reading green on a number nobody computed.
watchme.trigger: each read of the probe over ~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets — no clock and no new firing path; it rides the shim's existing pulse and the read-side overdue() door, the same seam every other probe in the corpus sits on. TRUE when at least 15 packets have berthed UNDER THE NEW DOOR (filename stamp >= 20260814T000000) and not one of them earned 'floor' for any field.
watchme.enough: CORRECTED AT THE BUILD, and the as-cast clause is kept above rather than rewritten (Law 7). As cast it read 'ENOUGH when that fraction is measured rather than declared, i.e. when no packet's provenance was authored by its sender' — which the build made UNFALSIFIABLE by construction: validate_orient now refuses a misdeclaration outright, so no berth can carry a sender-authored label and the clause is satisfied the instant the code lands. A watch that clears on the build that arms it is the check-goes-green-at-the-moment-its-condition-is-satisfied shape. CORRECTED: enough is reached when >= 15 post-door packets have berthed AND at least one field has EARNED 'floor' — an existence claim about reuse, which is the thing the code cannot prove about itself.
watchme.carrier: cairn/devices/builder/machines/orient/probes/floor_earns_its_label.py — module-level PROBE, carrying the post-door counts, the per-field tally, the derived floor fraction, and (as diagnostic data only, never a trigger) the berths whose declared label disagrees with re-derivation against TODAY's tree.
watchme.nexus: hypothesize — the finding is 'the label became honest and the floor's answer is still not reused', which is a hypothesis about why, not a fact about what.
watchme.consumer: harbor_master. It deposits and pokes and carries no authority: the back-edge that re-opens this ticket is the owner's act (Law 6). A fire means read skills/chart/SKILL.md stage 1 first — a zero here is usually the ceiling treating 'carry the floor's three fields through unchanged' as a suggestion, or packets berthing with no 'request' at all, which is the cheaper half to find and is carried in the same report.

dependencies: MEASURED, not assumed: floor_facts already computes every input the three fields need — component_roster, skill_roster, path existence — so half (1) is composition, not new machinery.

The inspector already has the tooth that guards a floor-authored ref: every_ref_exists_on_disk (orient.py:169) refuses any ref the floor cannot verify. It was built for ceiling-authored refs and applies unchanged.
skills/chart/SKILL.md stage 1 must change in the same act, because it is what instructs the ceiling; leaving it telling the ceiling to author refs would make the two mouths disagree.
NOT a dependency: Hex. This build is what gives Hex something to fail over FROM, but it needs nothing from hex.local and must not wait on it.
filed_edges: The same self-report exists in all six other nexi's packets and this ticket deliberately does not touch them (Akien's order is one at a time). But the dial's cross-nexus comparison becomes apples-to-oranges the moment orient lands, and nothing announces that. Either the dial grows a way to say which nexi are measured, or the reading is footnoted somewhere a reader will actually meet it.

If provenance is derived by comparing ceiling to floor, then a THIRD outcome exists that the current vocabulary cannot say: the ceiling EXTENDED the floor's answer rather than replacing it (adds a conceptual unknown to the floor's ungroundable ones). Today that collapses to 'claude' and loses the fact that the floor's part survived. Worth a value of its own once there is evidence about how often it happens — not invented before then.
